query:
update underway.task
                set state = 'failed'::underway.task_state,
                    updated_at = now(),
                    completed_at = now(),
                    lease_expires_at = null
                where id = $1
                  and task_queue_name = $2
                  and current_attempt = $3
                  and state = 'in_progress'::underway.task_state
